english.title: Permit materials / other object to remain on highway at night to the danger of traffic
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[an officer or servant of **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY AUTHORITY..), being the Highway Authority for **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..)]_
(B)_[an officer or servant of **(..SPECIFY NON-METROPOLITAN AUTHORITY..), the council maintaining **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..) by virtue of section 42 or 50 of the Highways Act 1980]_
(C)_[a person liable to maintain **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..) by reason of tenure, enclosure or prescription]_

who had caused a heap of materials or other objects, namely **(..SPECIFY MATERIALS OR OBJECTS..), to be laid on that highway, allowed it to remain there at night to the danger of traffic without taking all reasonable precautions for the prevention of accidents
english.legislation: Contrary to section 175 of the Highways Act 1980.
